description.fallback: With the unwitting help of his enemies' UV-based weapons, Kars has achieved his goal of becoming the Ultimate Thing! The transformation complete, he rises; the Stone Mask shatters, and the Red Stone of Aja falls to the ground. His arm, however, is still melting from the Ripple sent from Joseph's attack, giving Stroheim hope that he's not entirely invincible.
